tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Jovan speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Jovan speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Omar.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 2 people, 34 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 6 plants — 6 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.

Fresh-cut stems on the southwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southwest. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

The southwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southwest. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the southwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
🧳 A traveler from southwest says The Red Table is starving — Sanne's been seen counting empty jars, and the kids have gone quiet.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The little star inside Hugo goes quiet — and wakes up inside Barbara. Hugo never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Barbara will never be hungry again while it hums, and Hugo is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~1100 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

scaleLines.line: 📣 Anna stood down Night Court and kept walking. 1 rounds.
🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Heckler, Spool, Chorus Line, Night Court) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

🚨 The Heckler, Spool, Chorus Line, Night Court is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

🔥 The fire settles. Nina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at on
⚔️ Nina killed the Night Court with their party — 2 rounds, 5 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.

Dmitri leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Night Court. Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
On the carcass nearby, Night Court (carcass) went bad — maggots, smell, the whole sad story. Leaving it had a cost.

🧳 Word of Haven’s new bindings, the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Hungry Road has bound itself to Stonebridge. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."
